title: Australian special forces paid cash for US UAP retrieval operations
summary: Ross Coulthart tells of Australian special forces paid cash for US UAP retrieval operations, about unspecified at Unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And they told me they'd been involved in retrieval operations.

plain: An Australian investigative journalist, Ross Coulthart, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that members of Australian special forces told him they had been involved in operations to retrieve UAP, the official term for unidentified flying objects. According to the story, they were paid cash for helping the United States with these recoveries. If true, it would mean allied soldiers were quietly helping recover unknown craft.
